summary: Accelerant Holdings filed an 8-K reporting the expiration of the 40-day go-shop period under its August 13, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger with Cherry Tree BidCo and Cherry Tree Merger Sub, affiliates of Thoma Bravo Discover Fund V. The merger will make the Cayman-domiciled NYSE-listed insurer a wholly owned Thoma Bravo subsidiary. No price, premium, or close date is disclosed in this excerpt. A proxy statement and possible Schedule 13E-3 will follow for the shareholder vote; the lack of a topping bid during the go-shop leaves the original deal intact. Watch for proxy timing, any revised bid, and financing or regulatory conditions.
